## Purpose

Extracts NHDPlusV2 landscape variables for every COMID retained in
`03_snap_to_nhdplus.qmd`. The output is keyed by `comid` and keeps all
variables; choosing predictors happens in the final assembly script.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(arrow)
library(knitr)

fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",")
```

```{r}
#| label: paths
path_lookup        <- here("Data", "interim", "comid_lookup.csv")
path_landscape_csv <- here("Data", "external",
                           "nhdplusv2_landscape_variables_01302026_0952am.csv")
dir_landscape_pq   <- here("Data", "interim", "cache", "nhdplusv2_landscape")
path_out           <- here("Data", "interim", "landscape_nhd.csv")
```

## One-time conversion to Parquet

The source CSV is about 4.6 GB, and filtering it means scanning the whole
file every time. It's converted once to a Parquet dataset, streamed so it
never has to fit in memory. Later renders skip this chunk and query the
Parquet copy in seconds. Delete `dir_landscape_pq` to rebuild it if the CSV
changes.

```{r}
#| label: convert-parquet
if (!dir.exists(dir_landscape_pq)) {
  col_names <- names(read_csv(path_landscape_csv, n_max = 0,
                              show_col_types = FALSE))

  # Everything numeric except the three text columns
  schema_list <- setNames(rep(list(float64()), length(col_names)), col_names)
  for (col in c("gnis_name", "ftype", "summer_temp_mean_class")) {
    schema_list[[col]] <- string()
  }

  open_csv_dataset(path_landscape_csv,
                   schema = schema(schema_list),
                   skip   = 1) |>                  # header replaced by schema
    write_dataset(dir_landscape_pq, format = "parquet")
}

landscape_ds <- open_dataset(dir_landscape_pq)
```

The landscape table has **`r length(names(landscape_ds))`** columns.

## COMIDs to extract

```{r}
#| label: read-lookup
lookup <- read_csv(path_lookup, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(retained)

comids <- unique(lookup$comid)
```

`r fmt(nrow(lookup))` retained populations map to
**`r fmt(length(comids))`** unique COMIDs.

## Extract

```{r}
#| label: extract
landscape <- landscape_ds |>
  filter(comid %in% comids) |>
  collect()

stopifnot("COMID duplicated in landscape table" = !anyDuplicated(landscape$comid))

missing_comids <- setdiff(comids, landscape$comid)
pops_missing   <- filter(lookup, comid %in% missing_comids)
```

**`r fmt(nrow(landscape))`** of `r fmt(length(comids))` COMIDs are in the
landscape table. `r fmt(length(missing_comids))` are not, affecting
`r fmt(nrow(pops_missing))` populations.

## Derived variables

NHDPlusV2 elevations are stored in **centimetres**. Metre versions are added
alongside the originals; the original pipeline compared centimetres against a
250 m threshold.

```{r}
#| label: derive
landscape <- landscape |>
  mutate(
    lc_minelev_m  = lc_minelev / 100,
    lc_maxelev_m  = lc_maxelev / 100,
    lc_meanelev_m = (lc_minelev_m + lc_maxelev_m) / 2,
    lc_relief_m   = lc_maxelev_m - lc_minelev_m
  )
```

Mean catchment elevation ranges from
`r round(min(landscape$lc_meanelev_m, na.rm = TRUE))` to
`r fmt(round(max(landscape$lc_meanelev_m, na.rm = TRUE)))` m (median
`r round(median(landscape$lc_meanelev_m, na.rm = TRUE))` m).

## Variable groups

```{r}
#| label: variable-groups
tibble(variable = names(landscape)) |>
  mutate(group = case_when(
    startsWith(variable, "lc_") ~ "lc_  local catchment",
    startsWith(variable, "nc_") ~ "nc_  network (upstream) catchment",
    startsWith(variable, "lb_") ~ "lb_  local, land cover / impervious",
    startsWith(variable, "nb_") ~ "nb_  network, land cover / impervious",
    TRUE                        ~ "flowline attributes and other"
  )) |>
  count(group, name = "variables") |>
  kable()
```

The original pipeline kept only the `lc_` and `nc_` variables plus a few
flowline attributes. All columns are kept here so predictor choice can be
made once, by hypothesis and timescale, in the final assembly script.

## Missing values

```{r}
#| label: missingness
landscape |>
  summarise(across(everything(), \(x) sum(is.na(x)))) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable",
                      values_to = "comids_missing") |>
  filter(comids_missing > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(comids_missing)) |>
  mutate(share = paste0(round(100 * comids_missing / nrow(landscape), 1), "%")) |>
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

## Write output

```{r}
#| label: write-output
write_csv(landscape, path_out)
```

Wrote **`r fmt(nrow(landscape))`** COMIDs × `r ncol(landscape)` variables to
`r basename(path_out)`.
